a_idle.formula: t_fin = a_us*x0 + b_us_per_32tok_iter*x1 + extra_job_us_per_iter*x2 + extra_job_us*x3; a/b: x = [1, n_it, (m-1)*n_it, (m-1)], n_it = ceil(min(T,128)/32), m = jobs per finalizing CTA (a: ceil(NJOB/nidle), b: ceil(T/128)); c: x = [1, min(T,128)]; NJOB = (H/128)*ceil(T/128)

b_lastprod.formula: t_fin = a_us*x0 + b_us_per_32tok_iter*x1 + extra_job_us_per_iter*x2 + extra_job_us*x3; a/b: x = [1, n_it, (m-1)*n_it, (m-1)], n_it = ceil(min(T,128)/32), m = jobs per finalizing CTA (a: ceil(NJOB/nidle), b: ceil(T/128)); c: x = [1, min(T,128)]; NJOB = (H/128)*ceil(T/128)

c_all.formula: t_fin = a_us*x0 + b_us_per_token(T<=128)*x1; a/b: x = [1, n_it, (m-1)*n_it, (m-1)], n_it = ceil(min(T,128)/32), m = jobs per finalizing CTA (a: ceil(NJOB/nidle), b: ceil(T/128)); c: x = [1, min(T,128)]; NJOB = (H/128)*ceil(T/128)
